title: Over priced
body: Really beautiful UI, easy to use. However, they started to charge very expensive subscription fee in recent years. Even on sale time, it’s still several times expensive than similar app. I cannot see any updates or maintenance services that worth the continuing subscription fee. The app currently prompt ads every day of a 95% sale for life time use, which price is like 10 times expensive than other apps. Very annoying.
